cohort: 124 women aged 25-48 with CSD diagnosis by transvaginal ultrasonography (TVS) and hysteroscopy, without childbearing intention, at Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center between June 2017 and December 2018
finding: Hysteroscopic resection of CSD in women without childbearing intention resulted in improvement rates of CSD symptoms of 47.2% at 3 months and 65.6% at 6 months postoperatively.
mod_finding: Timing of surgery < 14 days was associated with better improvement at both 3 and 6 months, while having ≥2 prior cesarean sections was associated with lower improvement at 6 months.
